items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: He played with me. He played with me. He played with me.

ctx.x: We used Adolph Alexander on the Alto. Was that the young Adolph Alexander or his father? No, no. The young Alexander played with me once, you know, in my history. Yes. He played, coming playing saxophone, Tornet, and playing saxophone.

He played with me. He played with me. He played with me. I think he was a little older than me. I think he was a little older than me. Him and Joe Piaier, I believe, was an old Alto player. He played wrestling many times. We used Adolph Alexander on the Alto.
Is that the young Adolph Alexander or his father? No, no.

items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: The young Alexander played with me once, you know, in my history.

ctx.x: The man in the band though, the Adolph Alexander, is that Tatt's father? That's right.
That's Tatt's father. He was a very good old timeist, isn't he? He was a kid.
I never knew him, I heard of him though.
